reason: Checked against the source. sky_row has 3 callers, all JSRs (sky_draw &30D4, sky_zero &3142, sky_check in bank 4 &A329), and nothing else names it; it is not PROTECTED or generated, and it is not raster-timed. sky_rn is 1-8 on every entry: row 0 is sky_L+1 with sky_L = A AND 7; the middle rows are 8; the top row is what is left after subtracting 8 while it is >= 9, starting from H-(L+1) >= 15, because sky_H comes from sky_heights' nonzero 23-28 or from sky_h, which was saved from it. Split copies keep sky_rn. So (n-1) EOR 7 = 8-n holds. At exit A, Y, X, sky_n, sky_skip and s_ptr are unchanged, and Z/N come from the same byte. C differs, but sky_draw's part path sets C with ASL before its ADC, and sky_zero and sky_check use SEC before their SBC, so nobody reads it. Memory: the same absolute bank-4 workspace tables and zero-page variables are read and written in the same paging state, plus one fewer zero-page read. DEC A is valid on the 65SC12 and Baron already assembles it elsewhere. Size: 27 -> 23 bytes, with SKIP 4 after the RTS, so sky_draw, sky_zero and sky_img0 keep their addresses (the listing has them at &30D4/&313E/&317F) and the page layout is the same. Cycles: EOR #&FF, SEC, ADC #8 and LDA zp (9 cycles) are replaced by DEC A and EOR #7 (4 cycles), saving 5; the abs,X page crossings are the same reads.
